headline: Alaska Atmos Rewards Global Getaways: Monthly Award Sale Offers Up to 50% Off Economy to Key Destinations
reasoning: This topic has high travel relevance and reader value, directly impacting how travelers can save on flights to popular destinations. It is highly actionable and timely, as it's a monthly promotion with a short booking window, requiring immediate attention from readers. The source, One Mile at a Time, is a highly credible and established travel outlet for points and miles news.
summary: Alaska Atmos Rewards has launched its monthly Global Getaways promotion for July, offering up to 50% off economy award tickets to select destinations like Tokyo, Seoul, London, and Amsterdam. Bookings must be made by July 4, 2026, for travel between September 1 and November 15, 2026.

source_articles.title: Alaska Atmos Rewards’ Global Getaways Award Sale: Save Up To 50%
source_articles.excerpt: Alaska Atmos Rewards offers the Global Getaways promotion, whereby members can save on award tickets in select regions. While this promotion used to be quarterly, it’s now offered monthly, so there are more frequent offers, but a shorter booking window.
